regions.merged_text: God Bless you Miss Grace Panyard -- you and all the Panyard Family and associates -- with customers, employes, debetors and creditors. I do pray and hope things in God's own time and by His grace brighten up. You know as well as we all do that it has been quite a struggle for thousands of concerns to keep from bankrupsy this past winter. Thanks be to God the Panyards still holding on -- and please God will be enabled to "make the grade." We shall try and speed up our prayers in this regard. I thank you for your favor just noted but while things are so shakey I hardly expect such donations. However it may be for the best anyhow.
